english.title: Permit use of vehicle with optional lights not working
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was fitted with **(..SPECIFY OPTIONAL LAMP(S)/REFLECTOR(S)/REAR MARKING(S)/DEVICE(S)..) which did not comply with regulation 20 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989 in that **(..SPECIFY BREACH(ES )..).
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 20of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
